summary: Belmont County, OH tower, a 90-foot tower registered 2014; the original site is gone and the lookout list shows it relocated to Bethesda, standing.

facts.status_note: Not at the original site: the Ohio list shows the tower relocated to Bethesda and standing there

events.note: Date registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register: September 3, 2014

relocated Sewellsville tower at Bethesda, Belmont County, listed as standing

notes_for_editor: Thin record: the register gives only the 90-foot height, elevation, county and registration date. No build date, staffing, fire history or relocation date was found in the pages read, so no relocation event is recorded (the schema needs a year). The lookout list's Bethesda entry gives coordinates 40.01577 -81.08576, different from the original site's; nothing read ties the tower to Epworth Park. Sources read: register page, Ohio list, Bethesda village site, plus the Sewellsville index page at easternuslookouts.weebly.com (name and county only, not cited). Two web searches returned only general Bethesda and Sewellsville pages. Ask the Forest Fire Lookout Association's Ohio chapter or Belmont County historians for the move date and the tower's current access before publishing a visit note. The record's status 'relocated' fits.
